dan_words: All of the frames are looking good except for shot 3. We need some adjustments to that. For shot 3, if you look at the plates, that's not how a leg press machine is loaded. In addition to that, he's putting his foot on the plates rather than the platform. I need you to regenerate both of those shots. Make the leg press machine look realistic with the way a leg press machine is actually loaded. Make sure his feet are on the platform. Make sure when you generate this, the physics on this makes sense. I want to change his facial expression as well. I want the start frame to be him smiling, looking at the phone, and then the end frame is him smiling but also exerting himself, doing the rep. I want to emphasize here the importance of the physics on this. If this physics is off, you have to regenerate. Your budget is approved up to $20 for generations. Give me the new start and end frames for shot 3, and then we'll go on to the next round.
